projection.purpose: Keep literary authority separate from technical definitions.

contract.input: Author-owned documents, technical scene cards and localized text keys.
contract.authority: Authors decide narrative meaning; technical snapshots retain source status.
contract.step: Prepare an attributed import package and review its differences.
Compile that snapshot into immutable definitions.
contract.invariant: Google documents do not become executable game code by themselves.

test.given: An assistant proposes a new story interpretation.
test.then: The proposal remains unresolved until an actual authorial decision exists.
